0022600004.text: Both the Miami Heat and the Minnesota Timberwolves open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with Miami hosting. Miami's injury report lists Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), Pelle Larsson (illness), and Vladislav Goldin (ankle), all day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Rocco Zikarsky, who is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason. The Heat lost 0-2 to the Timberwolves in the 2025-26 season, including a 122-94 loss in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026.
